ai_result.long_description:
Handmade from premium genuine leather, this minimalist satchel is designed for everyday work, travel and daily use. Its structured silhouette combines a clean, timeless look with practical organization.

The bag features a spacious main compartment, a front pocket for quick access, a secure closure and an adjustable shoulder strap for comfortable crossbody carrying. It also includes durable metal hardware and a top handle for an additional carrying option.

Sized to hold a tablet, notebook, wallet and everyday essentials, it fits a small laptop up to 14”. The bag measures 14,17 × 10,62 × 3,14 in (36 cm × 27 cm × 8 cm). The adjustable shoulder strap extends up to 46,45 in, with a maximum length of 118 cm.

Its durable leather construction and understated design make it a practical work bag, travel companion or thoughtful gift for a boyfriend, husband, father or anyone who appreciates handmade craftsmanship.
